Apple iOS 27's Mail App promises one upgrade I've been hoping for for years: truly 'just works' search.

iOS 27 brings major search improvements to Apple Mail, making results more relevant and accurate

Apple's Mail App has long been criticized for its underwhelming search performance.

I think that statement is unlikely to spark any debate among anyone who's used the app for any length of time. In fact, some might say 'underwhelming' is putting it generously.

But iOS 27 is finally poised to deliver the search upgrade Apple Mail deserves.

Here is an excerpt from Apple's website introducing the new features in iOS 27:

I'm currently running the iOS 27 beta, and it further clarifies how the new ranking system will benefit users.

When you first open Search in the iOS 27 Mail app, you'll see a banner at the top that says 'Expanded Search Results.' It explains: 'Mail can find more results based on what you mean, not just what you type.'

Bottom line: Apple has finally brought search into the 21st century. Or, perhaps more accurately, it's just made search work the way it should have all along.

iOS 27 is still in beta, so it's too early to declare whether Apple has succeeded.

However, since this revamped search is likely tied to Siri and broader AI upgrades, I'm optimistic that Mail will finally deliver the search experience users deserve when iOS 27 launches officially this fall.

What do you think of Apple Mail's search currently? Have you tried the iOS 27 version? Let us know in the comments.
